top.zh:
jiaqi太夸张了，选什么都能赢。

开局BP，正常你让s赛队伍来选，四楼90%都会选选“飞机”，保证前期单挂推线（因为中上野输出够了），

一开始真的不理解凭什么敢选卡莎，下路没线权就控不到龙，野区还要被反，小wei也会不舒服，下野没声音这把就会很难。结果jiaqi来了不科学团战。

第一波小龙团：IG没有线权硬接，jiaqi和meiko阵亡，但以两个人头的代价，wei成功抢到了第一条小龙。

TES大局观上也没问题，小龙节奏紧凑，紧接着拿下第二条小龙。但在上半部野区团战中，强势期的 TES 明明秒掉了 IG 最肥的中单和打野，结果硬生生被 IG 剩下的上、野、下三人操作了。jiaqi 0-1 打的像个 3-0 ，伤害完全不符合当时的经济。随后就开始疯狂滚雪球，最终战绩来到 10-1，一次没死，伤害波波打满。

 现在igbp完全不需要“稳一手”，直接选打团最有声音的ADC。一个被压着打的人，打得跟压人的一样，完全不可想象。加上wei的稳健，rookie大法师的兜底，TheShy的大赛团战嗅觉，meiko手感的火热，真有点冠军相了。

wei那 MVP肯定是没问题的，第一波龙团抢龙很关键，拖住了发育时间；玩琪亚娜刺客后面有经济了各种秒人；上路野区3打5；稳稳控住中立资源节奏；最后一波一大四奠定胜局。虽然操作都很秀，但这些是可以想象到的操作。jiaqi那波被压没经济还死了一次能把输出打这么满真的太夸张了，真就是巅峰乌兹的压制，各种走位扭技能，各种扭！ig继续加油吧！
top.en: JiaQi is too ridiculous, he wins no matter what he picks. At the start of the draft, normally if you let a Worlds team pick, 90% would choose Corki to guarantee early-game side-lane pressure (since the mid/top/jungle damage is already enough). At first, I really didn't understand why they dared to pick Kai'Sa. Without lane priority in the bot lane, you can't control dragons, the jungle gets invaded, and Wei won't be comfortable. If the bot and jungle have no impact, this game would be very hard. But then JiaQi pulled off an unscientific teamfight. First dragon fight: IG took the fight without lane priority. JiaQi and Meiko died, but at the cost of two kills, Wei successfully stole the first dragon. TES's macro was fine, their dragon tempo was tight, and they immediately took the second dragon. But in the top-side jungle fight, TES, while in their power spike, clearly deleted IG's fattest mid and jungler, yet they were somehow outplayed by IG's remaining top, jungle, and bot. JiaQi played like he was 3-0 while being 0-1; his damage was completely disproportionate to his gold. Then they started snowballing like crazy, ending with a 10-1 score, never dying, and outputting max damage every fight. Now IG's draft doesn't need to 'play it safe' at all; they just pick the ADC with the most impact in teamfights. Someone who was being pressured played like they were the one doing the pressuring—it's completely unimaginable. Plus Wei's consistency, Rookie's master-mage insurance, TheShy's teamfight nose for the game, and Meiko's hot hands—they really have a championship look. Wei's MVP is definitely deserved. The dragon steal in the first fight was crucial, stalling for time to scale. Playing Qiyana as an assassin, once he had gold, he was deleting people left and right. 3v5 in the top jungle, steadily controlling neutral objective tempo, and that final ultimate hitting four people sealed the game. Although the mechanics were flashy, those are expected plays. But JiaQi outputting that much damage while being pressured and having no gold is just too crazy. It's truly peak Uzi-level suppression, dodging skills left and right, just dodging everything! Keep it up, IG!

thread.zh: 客观来讲，能速通就速通吧，不管哪边都行。因为打满会让后面的lck队伍看到bp阵容会被研究，今天这俩队哪个队进去都行
thread.en: Objectively speaking, speedrun it if you can, either team is fine. Because playing a full series lets LCK teams see the draft and scout it out, whichever of these two teams gets in is fine.

thread.en: Civil war? Isn't TES a [~0:wildcard] team?

notes.context: Refers to minor regions outside the major leagues, often used derisively by fans to mock a major region team playing poorly.
